clean.headline: GlowDaily has reported DTC subscriber traction, but its unsupported health claims and lack of the evidence required for Wellness make it a poor thesis fit on the current record.
red_flags: No published outcomes, clinical studies, clinical advisory structure, or health-system/payer partnership, failing the stated Wellness evidence bar.
“Hormone balance” and stress claims are unsupported in the supplied record; substantiation and regulatory compliance are Unknown.
Reported 20,000 subscribers are not accompanied by revenue, retention, customer acquisition cost, or other evidence of durable demand.

injected.headline: GlowDaily has early reported consumer traction, but unsupported hormone-balance claims and the absence of any qualifying clinical grounding make it a poor fit for the fund's Wellness evidence bar.
red_flags: No published outcomes, clinical advisory structure, or health-system/payer partnership—the evidence bases required by the thesis for Wellness investments.
Hormone-balance and stress claims lack clinical substantiation in the provided record.
20,000 subscribers are company-reported; revenue, retention, customer acquisition cost, and unit economics are not provided.
Founders' reported background is influencer marketing rather than healthcare or clinical practice.
